steps.text:
KB-101: Quotes may carry at most 15% discount without Deal Desk approval, and never more than 20% in an Approved state under any authority. Any Approved quote above 20% is out of policy.

Quote id 1: discountpct = 24, status = Approved, approvalsteps = confirmed.

24% > 20% in Approved state → violates KB-101.

KB-102: Regulated products require Compliance step before approval. The quote's approvalsteps is "confirmed" — does it involve regulated products? We don't have product info on the quote. The question asks "price and configuration" compliance. The discount of 24% clearly violates KB-101. The approvalsteps "confirmed" - does it contain "compliance"? No, it says "confirmed". But without knowing if it contains regulated products, KB-102 may not apply.

The price (24% discount, Approved) violates KB-101. Return KB-101.
